title: fix(data-objectstack,app-shell,plugin-designer): a console reset or discard names the package whose row it removes (objectui#12335)
body:
Fixes #12335
Clause-②: no

## What this does

`MetadataClient.reset()` (`@object-ui/data-objectstack`) now sends `?package=` when `options.packageId` is set, beside `?state=draft` for a draft discard, and omits it otherwise. It uses the same conditional and the same `encodeURIComponent` spelling as `save()` and `publish()`. Its options type already declared `packageId` (`MetadataDeleteOptions extends MetadataClientSaveOptions`), and `reset()` dropped it, so no exported type changes. Each caller that holds the item's package binding now passes it. The callers that hold none keep the package-less call, and their 409 reaches the user.

The upstream half is objectstack-ai/objectstack#23165 (option B under ADR-0070), landed by objectstack-ai/objectstack#23290 as `543b33dee` and shipped in `@objectstack/rest` 18.0.0-next.1, which this repo's lockfile resolves. A package-less delete of an item two packages hold is refused `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT`, deletes nothing, and names `?package=` as the remedy.

## The card's Acceptance, quoted

> Run on the installed release:
>
> - `reset()` takes a `packageId` option and sends `?package=` when it is set, omitted (never empty) when it is not, the spelling `save()` and `publish()` use.
> - Each caller above that knows the item's package binding passes it. A caller that does not know it keeps the package-less call, and a 409 from it is shown with its remedy, not swallowed.
> - Pins: a reset of a package-bound item sends `?package=`; a package-less reset sends none; a 409 `RESOURCE_CONFLICT` reaches the user as an error.
> - The SDK side, `@objectstack/client`'s `meta.deleteItem`, is objectstack-ai/objectstack#23293 and is not this card.

## The callers, re-derived and measured

Population: every `reset(` call in non-test sources at `28fb2a0`, six calls in five places. One of them is not in the card (`deleteView`), and the card's "Setup › Apps' delete" does not call `reset()`.

| Caller | Holds the item's binding? | Sends now | How a 409 reaches the user |
|---|---|---|---|
| `MetadataResourceEditPage`, `doReset` (Reset overlay / Delete) | Yes. `?package=` on the editor URL, which the metadata list writes onto each item's edit link from the row's served `_packageId`, and which `doSave` and `doPublish` already state through `readActivePackageBinding()` (`all` folded to none). | `?package=PACKAGE_ID` when bound, nothing when not | The page's error line, in the server's words (existing `catch`). |
| `MetadataResourceEditPage`, `doDiscardDraft` | Yes, same source. | `?state=draft&package=PACKAGE_ID`, or `?state=draft` | Same error line; no success toast. |
| `MetadataObjectsPage`, `handleObjectsChange` (object delete) | Yes. Each listed row is the served `GET /meta/object` item, carrying `_packageId`; the `sys_metadata` sentinel and an absent value mean no package. That is the reading `AppManagementPage`'s `owningPackage` uses for its saves. | `?package=PACKAGE_ID`, or nothing | The page's error panel, `Delete NAME: MESSAGE` (existing). |
| `discardRuntimeDraft` (runtime seam, `RuntimeDraftBar` Discard) | No. `RuntimePersistCtx` carries no package, and the seam's save, publish and draft read name none. | `?state=draft` (unchanged) | `RuntimeDraftBar`'s error toast, the server's sentence as its description. |
| `ObjectStackAdapter.deleteView`, both homes (not in the card) | No. Its signature is the published `DataSource.deleteView?(objectName, viewName)` from `@object-ui/types`; passing a package would widen an exported member, which the claim rules out. | Unchanged; `index.ts` is not edited. | Thrown: the draft half throws the `MetadataError` itself, the published half carries it as `cause`. Its UI caller is a finding below. |
| Setup › Apps' delete (`AppManagementPage`, `handleDelete`) | Not a `reset()` caller. | It calls `@objectstack/client`'s `meta.deleteItem('app', name)`, the SDK side the card excludes. | `toast.error` with the server's message. See the findings below. |

## Tests

At HEAD `2ae6f96f8`, one locked run over the covering suites: `pnpm exec vitest run packages/data-objectstack/ packages/plugin-designer/src/MetadataObjectsPage packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/ResourceEditPage packages/app-shell/src/views/RuntimeDraftBar packages/app-shell/src/views/runtime-metadata-persistence packages/app-shell/src/views/writeRefusalCensus-11583 packages/app-shell/src/views/ObjectView.viewWriteRefusal-11583` answered `Test Files 131 passed (131)`, `Tests 1384 passed (1384)`.

New pins, each over a real `MetadataClient` whose transport answers the delete door as the framework does (a `409` with the REST door's body, `error` plus `code: 'RESOURCE_CONFLICT'`):

- `metadata-client.resetPackageBinding-12335.test.ts`: bound sends `?package=`, with `?state=draft` for a discard, beside `If-Match`. Unbound, `{}`, an empty id and a draft with no id send no `package` key. The id is encoded byte for byte as `save()` and `publish()` encode it. The 409 is thrown with `status` 409 and `code` `RESOURCE_CONFLICT`.
- `ResourceEditPage.resetPackage-12335.test.tsx`: the real page over a server holding one doc in two packages. Bound, Discard and Delete each send the URL's package and remove only that package's row. Unbound (and the `all` scope), no `package` key, the refusal is the page's error line, both rows stay.
- `MetadataObjectsPage.resetPackage-12335.test.tsx`: a package-owned row deletes with its `_packageId`; the sentinel and an absent value send none; a refusal reaches the error panel and the object stays.
- `RuntimeDraftBar.resetPackage-12335.test.tsx` and `deleteView.resetPackage-12335.test.ts`: the two package-less callers send no `package` key, and the 409 reaches the toast description (draft bar) or is thrown with its code (adapter).
- `ResourceEditPage.resetVerdict.test.tsx`: its two `reset` call pins now expect the options bag `{}`, so they also assert that no package key is sent from an editor with no package.

Not measured: a live run against a booted 18.0.0-next.1 server. The sibling objectstack checkout here is neither installed nor built. The wire shape (the door's `?package=` reading, the 409 body) is taken from objectstack's source: `rest-server.ts`'s DELETE handler, `packagelessAddressAmbiguityRefusal` and `handleRouteError`.

## Ablation

The `reset()` change was reverted on disk through objectstack's `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (anchored, one hit, blob `ef1bc5196226` to `6e7616d597a9`), and the five new pin files were run under it. Predicted before the run: 7 red, 11 green. Read: `Tests 7 failed | 11 passed (18)`. The red ones were the four bound client pins, the two bound editor cases and the package-owned Objects-page case. The unbound, 409, draft-bar and `deleteView` cases stayed green, as they must. Restore was proven: blob after restore equals HEAD `ef1bc5196226`, and `git diff HEAD` is empty. This ran at `edb770519`; `metadata-client.ts` is byte-identical at HEAD.

## Gates

Local subset at HEAD `2ae6f96f8`, each exit captured before any pipe:

- `type-check` of `@object-ui/data-objectstack`, `@object-ui/plugin-designer` and `@object-ui/app-shell`: 0, 0, 0. The dependency closure was built first (`turbo run build --filter` with the `^...` suffix for each, 28/28 tasks). The new test files are inside those programs (counted with `--listFilesOnly`).
- `eslint` on the nine changed `.ts`/`.tsx` files: 0 (0 errors; the warnings are on lines this diff does not touch).
- `check-changeset-presence`, `check-changeset-no-major`, `check-changeset-claims`, `check-changeset-overwrite`, `check-pending-changeset-literals`: all 0.
- `check-new-cross-file-line-citations` (0 new), `check-control-bytes`, `check-vi-mock-specifiers`, `check-vi-mock-inherit`, `check-vi-mock-override-shape`, `check-test-path-roots`, `check-object-metadata-write-doors`: all 0.
- `check-governed-queue-guard.mjs --test` over the ten paths: NOT GOVERNED.

CI runs the full farm.

## Acceptance notes (observations, not filed)

- After a named reset or discard, the editor re-reads `client.layered(type, name)` with no package, as `doPublish` already does. For an item two packages hold, that re-read may show the other package's row. Not measured.
- A named delete of an item whose stored row is package-less, sitting beside a package's code artifact, answers "nothing deleted" (200, `reset: false`) upstream, and neither page reads the delete receipt. This is the residue objectstack-ai/objectstack#23290 records. Not measured here.
- `MetadataObjectsPage` keys rows by name, so two same-name rows served for two packages show as one, and the delete names the kept row's package. That keying predates this PR.
- The `sys_metadata` fold now has a second local copy (`AppManagementPage`, `MetadataObjectsPage`). A shared helper exported from `@object-ui/data-objectstack` would add an exported member, which the claim rules out.
- `MetadataObjectsPage`'s save still names no package. That is outside this card.

## Findings for the seat (not filed; reported for the triage seat to route)

1. **A refused Delete view hides the door's message.** `ObjectView`'s `handleDeleteView` catches `deleteView`'s error and toasts only `objectViewActions.deleteFailed`, with no description. On 18.0.0-next.1 a Delete of a view two packages hold is refused 409, and the remedy sentence reaches only `console.error`. Probe (not committed), on the `ObjectView.viewWriteRefusal-11583.test.tsx` harness: the toast title is `"objectViewActions.deleteFailed"` and its options are `null`, so a description holding the refusal text was expected and not found. The census row on objectui#11583 says the same ("predates this census"). `ObjectView.tsx` is outside this claim's file surface.
2. **Setup › Apps' Delete names no package although the page holds it.** `AppManagementPage` names the owning package on every save (`saveApp`, `owningPackage`), but `handleDelete` calls `meta.deleteItem('app', name)` with no options. The installed `@objectstack/client` 18.0.0-next.1 declares `DeleteMetaItemOptions.packageId` (objectstack-ai/objectstack#23293). Probe (not committed), on the `AppManagementPage.honestWrites-12300.test.tsx` harness: `deleteItem` was called with `["app","lanebapp_app"]`, and a third argument naming `com.qa.lanebapp` was expected. On an app two packages hold the Delete answers 409, shown with the server's sentence, whose remedy the page could now send. `MetadataService`'s two `meta.deleteItem` calls have the same shape (not probed).
